title: 视觉语言模型中的可靠性：注意力、隐藏状态与因果电路的机制研究
summary: 本文通过统一机制管道VRP研究VLM可靠性，发现注意力结构几乎无法预测正确性，而隐藏状态线性探针可达AUROC>0.95。因果神经元消融揭示架构差异：晚期融合模型可靠性集中在脆弱瓶颈，早期融合模型分布广泛。
summary_en: This paper studies VLM reliability via a unified mechanistic pipeline (VRP), finding attention structure is a near-zero predictor of correctness while hidden-state linear probes achieve AUROC>0.95. Causal neuron ablations reveal architectural splits: late-fusion models concentrate reliability in a fragile bottleneck, early-fusion models distribute it widely.
